name: print-social-word-play-cocktail-collage-post
title: Word-play post with cutout animals and a cherry cocktail
whatItIs: A 4:5 cream post with grainy texture. A royal-blue pill holds the quoted word, a two-line blue caption follows, and cut-out photos of a cockroach, a hen and a glossy cherry cocktail form a collage, with a pixel heart and glittery magenta star.
whatItMeans: Witty and irreverent; the surreal mix of animals and drink teases the double meaning.
techniques: Illustrate a pun with unexpected cut-out objects that each hint at a meaning.
Contrast grainy paper-like background with glossy hi-res photos.
Anchor the message with one saturated blue pill and matching caption.
Sprinkle small pixel and glitter stickers for playfulness.

vocabulary.definition: Fine noise added for a paper or print feel.
An image built to illustrate a double meaning.
A sparkling shape used as accent.
